question: Do two separately pretrained EEG encoders produce similar within-block geometry and change magnitudes on identical ear-EEG inputs, and is that alignment greater than on paired phase-scrambled inputs?
scope: Exploratory development comparison using the exact exposed Experiment010 selection. Two distinct backbones; shared architecture and scalp pretraining remain possible explanations. No model fitting, labels, identity, history or semantics in discovery; no literal token-ID equivalence.

selection.rule: Use all and only the122 ELIGIBLE rows in original array order from010; verify archive, per-block hashes, candidate-index order and every baseline array. Do not acquire or inspect further waves for011. Original5760-candidate QC census remains inherited context, not new exposure.

codebrain.reuse: Reuse the610 archived full-grid outputs, independently checking archive and all per-output input/output hashes. No second CodeBrain run is needed unless a verified corruption requires an explicitly recorded recovery.

cbramod.device: CPU float32, one numerical thread, eval/inference, frozen strict-loaded actual weights
cbramod.implementation_gate: Require accepted eco-uzwh8s.30 independent adapter review before actual scientific inference. Seal final code hashes in a run manifest before inference.

preprocessing.rule: Exactly the010 prepared microvolt/100 numerical arrays and inherited preprocessing. No new filter, reference, normalization, channel mapping or resizing. The historical60Hz notch on a50Hz dataset remains a declared limitation.

variant_definition: Use unchanged pretrained_study.waveform_variant with seed9009+candidate_index, as010. Check every variant input hash against010 inference. Independent phase is the SAME transformed input in both models; it preserves per-channel Fourier magnitude but changes local timing/interchannel phase. It is a nuisance comparator, not an assumption-free biological null.

representation.pool: Arithmetic mean over four channel embeddings, then retain indices1..28, centers1.5..28.5seconds, yielding28x200 for each model. All vectors have full30second context.
representation.geometry: Spearman correlation with average ties of the378 upper-triangle cosine distances among28 vectors in modelA versus modelB.
representation.change: Spearman correlation with average ties of27 adjacent cosine-distance magnitudes in modelA versus modelB. This measures aligned contextual change magnitudes, not discrete inflection localization.
representation.abstention: Any nonfinite, zero-norm or constant distance vector abstains with explicit reason. No substituted zero, smoothing, fitted alignment or vector rotation.

primary.block_effect: For each selected block and metric compute cross-model rho(original) minus cross-model rho(independent_phase); retain only rows where both are finite. A separate validity set for each metric is reported.
primary.aggregate: Within each source recording, median block delta with >=3 valid paired blocks. Mean its two session medians for each complete person. Unweighted mean of complete person effects. Report every block, recording and person, including exclusions and incomplete person003.
primary.test: Exact two-sided participant sign-flip test over all2^n sign combinations on the n complete-person effects. Null requires independent people and sign-symmetry of person effects under zero contrast; shared device/protocol/architecture artifacts are not ruled out. p=count(abs(mean(signed effects)) >= abs(observed mean)-1e-12)/2^n, including identity and its negative; no Monte Carlo plus-one.
primary.multiplicity: Bonferroni across exactly2 primary tests; corrected p=min(1,2*p).
primary.small_sample_limit: For expected n=5 the minimum attainable unadjusted two-sided p is2/32=.0625, corrected .125. This experiment estimates patterns; it cannot establish a population claim at conventional .05 with this test.
primary.missing: If <3 complete people, report INSUFFICIENT_PARTICIPANTS and all descriptive values; do not tune selection or thresholds.

secondary.cross_model: For all5 variants report geometry/change rho using the same nested record/session/person aggregation, separate transparent denominators. Descriptive, no additional p-values.
secondary.within_model_controls: For each model and each4 transformed variants versus original, report geometry rho, change rho, RMS embedding displacement and maximum input amplitude. Same original-selected support; descriptive only.
secondary.transparent_descriptors: For each model original versus the inherited morphology,spectrum,coordination descriptors report geometry and change rho using existing cosine-versus-RMS-Euclidean definitions and frozen003 standardization. Descriptor inputs are numerical views of the same waves, not independent truth. Descriptive only.
secondary.absolute_original_and_phase: Alongside delta report original and phase values on identical paired-valid rows, with every person effect. Do not compare differently supported aggregate means as a paired effect.

output_contract.arrays: Archive full CBraMod float32[122,5,4,30,200] grid, candidate_indices and ordered variants. Hash each input/output and the compressed archive.
output_contract.ledger: analysis.sqlite with candidate identities/eligibility, block cross-model metrics, paired effects, descriptors and within-model controls, primary/source/foreign-key checks; canonical summary JSON contains all planned results and status. No unpublished best-run selection.
output_contract.provenance: Freeze protocol hash before inference, seal final analysis/adapter/vendor/dependency/input hashes; record wall clock, exact versions, CPU/RSS, all610forward timings. Reruns use a separate directory and immutable receipts.
output_contract.reproduction: Provide actual offline evaluation command consuming only included prepared/baseline arrays and two embedding archives. Extracted release must reproduce numerical summary within declared1e-12 floating tolerance; ignore wallclock only. Also publish licensed code/source/weight links.

prior_exposure: 010 selection and CodeBrain results were known when writing this protocol. CBraMod adapter smoke used first and last selected blocks and synthetic input before this freeze; no cross-model agreement outcome was calculated or inspected. This is outcome-prespecified development analysis, not pristine preregistration. The two smoke blocks remain disclosed, not selectively removed.
reserve: EESM23 participants007-010 and all unexamined later sessions remain unopened until separately frozen validation. EESM19 development intake belongs to another task, not011.
claims: Any agreement concerns these contextual continuous features on one exposed ear-EEG dataset. Distinct encoders do not prove disjoint pretraining, universal brain tokens, semantic meaning, diagnosis or physical Neurable transfer. Publish low, null, reversed and artifact-compatible findings.
